thread:
zara_sec: Observed a ~1.9k spike in TLS handshake rejects from ap-south ingress to svc-billing. Errors show client cert CN=something-legacy. Possibly related to last-week RBAC regrouping.

mike_sre: Sample ingress lines:
```
2026-04-02T11:13:41Z ingress-aps svc-billing=\"svc-billing-01\" tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate (client CN=svc-billing-legacy, expected svc-billing)
```

ana_infra: We moved keystore ownership into group infra-ops on 2026-04-01. Could be an orphaned project-level binding. I'll check KMS audit.

rotator-bot: rotator: rotation job keystore-billing-aps-20260402-01 completed at 2026-04-02T03:30:00Z. Principal used: rotator-sa@infra.redwood.

ana_infra: KMS audit snippet around rotation: 
{"timestamp":"2026-04-02T03:30:01Z","principal":"svc-billing-legacy@infra.redwood","action":"Decrypt"}
{"timestamp":"2026-04-02T03:30:02Z","principal":"rotator-sa@infra.redwood","action":"Decrypt"}

cleo_dev: That matches: legacy SA still had decrypt rights and minted certs during rollout. Mitigation: 1) remove orphan IAM binding (ana), 2) re-run canary rotation with rotator-sa, 3) add alert: any KMS decrypt by non-rotator principal pages sec-oncall.

ana_infra: Removed binding at 2026-04-02T11:28:10Z and re-ran canary. rotator-bot: canary rotation keystore-billing-aps-20260402-02 completed at 2026-04-02T11:29:40Z, CN=svc-billing.

mike_sre: Handshake rejects returned to baseline after 11:31Z. Root cause: leftover project-level IAM binding after RBAC consolidation. Follow-ups: infra to reconcile terraform state, ops to add KMS-decrypt principal alert, dev to add rotator pre-check for unexpected principals.

zara_sec: Filing P2 incident. Will document RCA and lessons learned in weekly sec sync.
